name: Speedy
summary: +1 Dex or Con; +10 feet of Speed, Dash through Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

benefits.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
benefits.summary: After you Dash on your turn, Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement for the rest of that turn.
benefits.text: When you take the Dash action on your turn, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

benefits.name: Agile Movement
benefits.summary: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
benefits.text: Opportunity Attacks made against you have Disadvantage.
